title: Kart Duel
description: Race against three computer karts around a colourful circuit. Take the inside line, hit the boost pads and finish first after three laps.
instructions: Up / W to drive, Down / S to brake, Left and Right to steer.
On touch screens, use the on-screen buttons.
Drive over the arrow pads for a speed boost.
Finish 3 laps ahead of the other karts.
